[SKU-V04 / VENDOR / ORACLE WMS CLOUD]

Oracle WMS Cloud cost

Oracle WMS Cloud is the LogFire heritage WMS folded into Oracle Fusion SCM on OCI. Subscription is priced by order/shipment volume plus named users. Third-party guidance puts entry at ~$3,000/month with a $25K annual minimum.

Quote onlyENTERPRISE / saassource ->
[SKU-A / PRICING POSTURE]

Quote-only

Subscription per shipment/order volume + named users; quote only[s-05].

[SKU-B / COST DRIVERS]

What changes the quote

  • Monthly shipment / order volume tiers.
  • Named users (warehouse operators, supervisors, managers all counted).
  • Module pile-on: TMS, OTM, Logistics Network Modeling priced separately.
  • OCI consumption for storage and integration outside the included tier.
[SKU-C / RECENT CHANGES]

2025-26 product and pricing

Oracle has folded WMS Cloud deeper into the OCI Fusion SCM stack. AI/ML labour planning and yard management features added 2025-26 with no list-price changes published.

[SKU-D / FIT]

When this vendor is the answer

  • Existing Oracle Cloud SCM customer running Fusion ERP or NetSuite-to-Fusion migration.
  • Multi-site retailer wanting WMS + TMS on one cloud.
  • 3PL with high shipment volume where the per-shipment model still beats per-user.
[SKU-E / FAQ]

Buyer questions

What is the difference between Oracle WMS Cloud and SCM Cloud Logistics?

WMS Cloud is the LogFire-heritage warehouse execution layer. SCM Cloud Logistics covers TMS, OTM, and Logistics Network Modeling. They co-sell.

Per-user, per-shipment, or both?

Both. Oracle prices a platform fee + per-shipment tier + named users. The blend is configured per deal.

Oracle vs SAP EWM?

See /vs/sap-ewm-vs-oracle-wms. Short answer: pick Oracle if you are on Oracle Cloud SCM. Pick SAP EWM if you are on S/4HANA. Cross-vendor (Oracle WMS on SAP, EWM on Oracle ERP) is rare and adds integration cost.
